responsibility: Provides the semantic action layer used by the parser and template instantiator to build higher-level C++ constructs. It manages deferred access-checking state, creates and finishes many front-end expressions and statements, handles lambda capture typing, fold expressions, builtin semantic wrappers such as __builtin_launder/__builtin_convertvector/__builtin_bit_cast, and other statement/expression formation tasks that sit between grammar parsing and lower-level type-checking routines.
